exposure: Breastfeeding Self-Efficacy Enhancement Program with LINE Application
cohort: Fifty-two pregnant women preparing for cesarean section at a university hospital in central Thailand were divided into experimental and control groups.
finding: The Breastfeeding Self-Efficacy Enhancement Program with LINE Application led to higher mean scores of breastfeeding self-efficacy and rates of exclusive breastfeeding in the experimental group compared to the control group.
mod_finding: The Breastfeeding Self-Efficacy Enhancement Program with LINE Application contributed to higher breastfeeding self-efficacy and rates of exclusive breastfeeding for mothers who had a cesarean section.
